title: Broken hearts
html_source:
Another of many references to broken hearts in this chapter. Mr Power seems to be making a broad observation, but Mr Dedalus' mind goes immediately to the recent death of his wife, Stephen’s mother, Mary Dedalus, who is buried in Glasnevin.

Simon Dedalus may be thinking of his own broken heart, or perhaps, that his mistreatment of Mary broke her heart.
